_comment: External vulnerability feed for qrubyscanner. Load with --vuln-feed <file-or-url> (repeatable). Entries are MERGED on top of the built-in catalogue; EOL dates override by branch. A version matches an entry when ANY of its 'affected' ranges match. Within a range, every populated bound must hold: 'branch' pins a major.minor; 'introduced' is an inclusive lower bound; 'fixed'/'lt' are exclusive upper bounds; 'eq' is one exact version. Versions may have four components (7.0.8.1) or a Ruby patch level (2.0.0p594). 'ruby' entries apply to CRuby; 'cms' is keyed by framework / application / stack component (rails, rack, sinatra, gitlab, mastodon, passenger ...); 'packages' is keyed by gem name.
